wiki.title: Elijah Pierick
wiki.extract: Elijah Isaiah Pierick (born November 28, 1994) is an American politician serving in the Hawaii House of Representatives for the 39th district encompassing Royal Kunia, Village Park, Honouliuli, and Hoopili. A member of the Republican Party, he won the seat in the 2022 election against Democratic nominee Corey Rosenlee, flipping the seat. He has served as House Minority Whip since January 2026.
